people.name: FABRI, Charles Louis – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: six years of studies of philosophy, psychology and Germanic philology at Pécs University... M.A. 1924, Ph.D. 1927 Pécs, in philosophy (diss. on William Jones).

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: from there Fabri proceeded to the Netherlands in 1927 and studied at Kern Institute in Leiden under Vogel.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: Fabri proceeded to the Netherlands in 1927 and studied at Kern Institute in Leiden under Vogel.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: Also studies under Lévi in Paris.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: He became Assistant of Vogel and worked on the ABIA until 1933.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: In 1931 he was in India in order to work as an assistant of M. A. Stein (with him in the Punjab and Baluchistan).

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: In 1934 moved permanently to India, first taught at Santiniketan.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: He was then special officer of A.S.I., in 1936-37 in Lahore Museum. Leaving A.S.I. in 1938/39

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: Leaving A.S.I. in 1938/39 he became Field Director of Punjab Exploration Fund and conducted excavations on several sites.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: After the war in 1945 he became Curator of Lahore Museum, but in December 1947 had to move to Delhi.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.evidence: Now National Museum Lecturer in New Delhi in 1947-48.

relations.subject: Charles Louis Fabri
relations.role: Lecturer at Architecture and Art Departments
relations.evidence: In 1950-55 (or 1959) he was also Lecturer at Architecture and Art Departments of Delhi Polytechnic.
